title: Valheim linked storage
scope: Solo native combined chest grid for up to four containers explicitly linked to one workbench. Chopping-block range and connection effect; crafting, item upgrades and construction from linked contents. Natural Meadows necks spawn normally initially; cleared zones recover after a saved random seven to fourteen Valheim days. A distant cirrus spectrum appears from 09:00 to 15:00 game time, behind foreground clouds.
